name: scoop-md-crawler
description: Browser crawler for client-rendered docs sites; runs inside an E2B sandbox.

scripts.template:build: npm run sync && e2b template create scoop-crawler --dockerfile e2b.Dockerfile --cmd 'cd /home/user/crawler && node server.js' --ready-cmd 'curl -sf http://localhost:8080/health' --cpu-count 2 --memory-mb 2048
